name: taskora
description: Taskora — a local services marketplace. Root scripts orchestrate the server (Express + PostgreSQL) and client (React + Vite) for local dev and for a single-service Render deployment.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.start: npm run migrate --prefix server && npm run start --prefix server
